title: Mitral edge-to-edge repair
scope: A schematic clip design on representative mitral anatomy, not to scale. It represents a group of devices rather than any product. Leaflets, chordae and papillary muscles are representative, and every position shown is drawn by hand, not measured. No leaflet mechanics, grasp, residual regurgitation, flow or fit is computed.
stageLabel: Schematic, not to scale. Representative poses.
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

designs.label: Edge-to-edge clip
designs.summary: Two arms from a shared hinge hold the middle of the leaflets together from below, with grippers above them.

states.label: 1. Native valve open
states.note: Representative open pose. Leaflets and chordae are representative, not taken from imaging.

states.label: 2. Native valve closed
states.note: Representative closed pose, with the leaflets meeting along a line. No disease is shown.

states.label: 3. Clip arms open
states.note: The clip is below the leaflets with its arms open and its grippers raised, before grasping.

states.label: 4. Grippers lowered, arms closing
states.note: Intermediate representative grasp pose. The leaflets are brought toward the arms; no grasp mechanics are calculated.

states.label: 5. Clip closed, valve closed
states.note: Arms closed with both leaflets captured. The leaflets meet along the line and around the clip. Representative, not computed.

states.label: 6. Clip closed, valve open
states.note: The same clip, still closed. Only the leaflets move, opening on each side of it. Representative, not computed.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Where the clip sits in the heart
views.lesson: The enlarged marker locates the mitral valve between the left chambers.

views.label: Left chambers
views.title: See the mitral valve between the left chambers
views.lesson: The left atrium and left ventricle of a real heart are opened along their long axis. Follow the clip from arms open below the leaflets to the grasp, then see the valve close and open on both sides of the clip.

views.label: Local approach
views.title: Approach from the left atrium
views.lesson: A transseptal example approaches the mitral valve from the left atrium. The arrow shows only the local segment.

views.label: From the atrium
views.title: Looking down on the leaflets
views.lesson: Step through the states to compare the native valve with the clipped valve.

views.label: Long axis
views.title: Clip, leaflets and chordae from the side
views.lesson: A smooth representative tissue section reveals the leaflet, gripper and arm relationship. Compare each pose with the camera held fixed.

views.label: From the ventricle
views.title: Looking up at the clip
views.lesson: Chordae fan from each papillary muscle to both leaflets.

views.label: Clip alone
views.title: The clip with its arms open and closed
views.lesson: The arms and grippers are drawn as a generic design. Their proportions are representative.

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The enlarged marker indicates the approximate mitral valve location.

ring.label: ANNULUS LEVEL
ring.body: A representative ring marking where the atrium meets the ventricle. It marks a level and is not a measured annulus.

anterior.label: ANTERIOR LEAFLET
anterior.body: A representative surface on the aortic side of the valve, not taken from imaging.

posterior.label: POSTERIOR LEAFLET
posterior.body: A representative surface on the far side from the aorta, drawn with scallops, not taken from imaging.

coaptation.label: WHERE THE LEAFLETS MEET
coaptation.body: With the valve closed, the two leaflets meet along a line. Beside the clip they still meet in this illustration.

chordae.label: CHORDAE
chordae.body: Representative chords, branching from the papillary muscles to both leaflets. Their number and paths are representative.

papillary.label: PAPILLARY MUSCLE
papillary.body: A representative muscle column with several heads, rising from the ventricular wall. The source anatomy does not contain it.

arm.label: ARMS HOLD THE LEAFLETS
arm.body: From the ventricular side, the closed arms bring the middle of the two leaflets together. The class mechanism is leaflet approximation.

openarm.label: ARMS OPEN
openarm.body: Before grasping, the arms open below the leaflets. They close once the leaflets rest on them.

gripper.label: GRIPPERS
gripper.body: From the atrial side, a gripper holds each leaflet against its arm. Fine detail is omitted.

opengripper.label: GRIPPERS RAISED
opengripper.body: Raised above the arms until the leaflets are in position, then lowered onto them.

hub.label: ATRIAL END
hub.body: The clip is reached from the left atrium, so this end faces the atrium. The delivery system is not shown.

orifice.label: OPENING, ONE SIDE
orifice.body: With the valve open, the held middle leaves an opening on each side of the clip. Opening sizes are representative, and no flow is computed.

orifice2.label: OPENING, OTHER SIDE
orifice2.body: The second opening. Opening sizes are representative, and no flow is computed.

grasp.label: GRASP IN PROGRESS
grasp.body: An intermediate representative pose separates gripper lowering from the final closed clip. This sequence is representative, not a computed grasp.

baseblend.label: REPRESENTATIVE BASE SUPPORT
baseblend.body: A broad representative continuation joins each papillary base to the local wall. It is added for anatomical orientation, not a measured tissue surface or a mechanics result.

regional_la.label: LEFT ATRIUM
regional_la.body: The left atrium sits above the valve. Its shape comes from a real heart, opened along its long axis.

regional_valve.label: MITRAL VALVE
regional_valve.body: The two leaflets hang from the ring where the atrium joins the ventricle. Leaflet shape is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.

regional_lv.label: LEFT VENTRICLE
regional_lv.body: The left ventricle sits below the valve. Its cavity and wall shape come from the same real heart.

regional_aorta.label: AORTIC ROOT
regional_aorta.body: The aortic root sits beside the front leaflet of the mitral valve and helps with orientation.

regional_support.label: PAPILLARY MUSCLES
regional_support.body: Two papillary muscles rise from the ventricular wall. Cords fan out from their tips to the leaflet edges. Their shapes are representative.

regional_device.label: GENERIC EDGE-TO-EDGE CLIP
regional_device.body: The clip holds the two leaflet edges together. It is drawn larger here so it can be seen. Its shape is representative, not a specific product.

region_access.label: ATRIAL APPROACH
region_access.body: In this transseptal example the device approaches the mitral valve from the left atrium. The path is schematic.
